judgment.rationale: The submission provides a usable first-level workflow and digital-platform blueprint. It preserves ER, Quality and Purchase TRSO signoff and Finance, Quality, ER and Program nomination signoffs. Its price-change gate explicitly requires Finance controllers, Program Managers and Purchase for every price change, consistent with the approved, in-force workspace record rather than the unapproved draft. The modular quotation structure covers features, design elements, child parts and raw materials, with configuration pricing, separate one-time charges, compatibility controls and safeguards against double counting. Post-nomination fast and exception paths retain mandatory approvals while reusing unaffected evidence. Version-bound approvals, baseline preservation, communication records, audit history, release controls and stakeholder visibility support traceability and governance. Implementation questions are appropriately left for validation rather than presented as established facts.
